art_direction: 一只翠鸟停在弯曲芦苇上，薄荷留白与橘色腹部形成简洁弧形构图。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: A single kingfisher perches near the center on a reed that bends into an incomplete circle. Reduce the bird to four decisive painted shapes: a deep teal back, a small burnt orange breast, an ivory throat, and a charcoal beak. Let its head turn toward the empty center of the reed arc. Use a pale mint ground with abundant unmarked space and only one narrow reed leaf. The silhouette should read immediately in a small square avatar. Keep the feather treatment flat and sparse, with one tiny eye and a crisp outer contour; omit water scenery, decorative lettering, and a surrounding frame.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
